newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY MAJOR ISSUES.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 RISES AT FIXING LED BY MAJOR ISSUES.

text.p: Czech shares edged higher again on Monday with most of the upward pressure coming from the highly capitalised shares.
SPT Telecom gained 41 crowns to 3,040, CEZ was up 10 crowns to 911, Komercni Banka rose 56 crowns to 1,928 and Ceska Sporitelna edged one crown to 290.
Zivnostenska Banka was unchanged on 2,300. Zivnostenska on Monday announced it would pay 160 crown gross dividend on 1996 profits, the same as the year before.
